scripts.dev: npm run build -w @queueless/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @queueless/api" "npm run dev -w @queueless/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @queueless/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @queueless/shared && npm run build -w @queueless/api && npm run build -w @queueless/web
